$doc: User flows — the intent layer. graph.json is the mechanism (what every control does); this file says which journeys the product owes, in words a person can check. `check-flows.mjs` resolves each one against the graph by searching `advance` edges alone and writes the result to flows.resolved.json, the committed witness. A flow declares: `name` (kebab-case) · `description` (its intent in one line) · `start` · optional `waypoints` · `end`. START is either a board (`{board}` — the journey begins on that screen), a given edge (`{board, via}` plus `case`/`to` when that edge offers several outcomes), or a CONTROL (`{control}` — the click, not the screen: it expands to every edge carrying that label, which must all land on the same first board; `except` drops boards that mean something else there). END is a given edge `{board, via}` (plus `case`/`to`), the concluding act. A flow may OMIT `end` instead, and then concludes on ARRIVAL at the board its last point lands on — the start's landing board when it declares no waypoints, the last waypoint's board when it does; the witness reads `end · arrival at <Board>`. That is the shape of a reading journey, which reaches what it came for and has no signing act to name. A GAP counts differently at the two ends: on an end it resolves the flow as BLOCKED, an honest claim on design still owed, while on a start it FAILS, because a journey that can begin from no existing screen is an authoring error rather than a claim. So a given start edge that opens a gap fails, and so does a control whose every origin reaches only a gap; a control with merely some such origins resolves and lists them under `startsUndesigned`. WAYPOINTS are ordered boards the journey passes through; a waypoint's `via` (with `case` or `to`) pins the edge the flow LEAVES that board by, which is how an ambiguous leg is settled — to pin the very first step, name the start board as the first waypoint. Start and end edges are given, never searched, so their kind does not matter; every leg between two points is searched, and a leg that resolves two ways is a hard failure asking for a pin. FORMATTING: one flow per block, one waypoint per line, hand-edited. Never let a script rewrite this file.

flows.name: publish-a-post
flows.description: The bottom nav's New post opens the wizard on every tab root; pictures are cropped, described, and signed into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-avatar-standalone
flows.description: The change badge on your own profile picture goes straight to the crop and its own seal — one signature, the picture alone.

end.case: signed — shown everywhere you appear

flows.name: edit-avatar-via-edit-screen
flows.description: Changing the picture from the edit screen returns to it — one seal covers the picture and the fields together.

waypoints.case: come from the edit screen — the edit's one seal signs it

end.case: signed — the profile updates

flows.name: narrow-the-feed
flows.description: The band's filter trigger opens the filter sheet; the sheet applies live, and tapping out leaves the reader on the narrowed feed.

end.case: narrowed

flows.name: sign-in
flows.description: Email and password on the sign-in screen land a member with their key on this device in their own feed.

end.case: member, key on this device

flows.name: reply-to-a-post
flows.description: The comment count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the thread sheet; Add a comment opens the composer, and the seal signs the reply back into the thread.

end.case: signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: open-a-topic
flows.description: A topic chip on a post opens that topic's page — the page itself is still owed.

flows.name: sign-in-with-the-key-elsewhere
flows.description: The same sign-in on a device the key is not on — reading runs, and anything signed waits until the key is restored.

end.case: member, key not here

flows.name: join-with-an-invite
flows.description: An invite link checks out at the door, then handle, email and password make the account and the applicant days begin.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: guest-turns-applicant
flows.description: Sign in or join, offered on every guest screen, runs out to the invite and through Create account into the applicant days.

end.case: account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: verify-the-email
flows.description: Back to CoGra in the verification mail returns an applicant to the feed their application still runs in.

end.case: application still running

flows.name: verify-the-email-as-a-member
flows.description: The same mail opened once the application has been approved lands a full member in their own feed.

end.case: already a member

flows.name: make-your-key
flows.description: Create my key runs the ceremony — the recovery code shown, written down, confirmed — and hands the applicant back where it began.

end.case: code confirmed — returns where the ceremony began

flows.name: vouch-back-for-your-inviter
flows.description: Vouch back on the approval landing opens the stance pad; the signed stance ends the borrowed view and the member's own feed opens.

end.case: the vouch-back — signed, the way opens

flows.name: restore-your-key
flows.description: Restore the key, wherever the key-absent screens offer it, takes the recovery code and returns to whatever was waiting on it.

end.case: key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: publish-your-payout-address
flows.description: The wallet's first open makes the key and signs the payout address onto the record — the wallet then stands at zero, address published.

end.case: published — the zero wallet, address on record

flows.name: change-your-payout-address
flows.description: Change on the wallet takes a new address to its own seal; the signed change puts it on record, newest wins.

end.case: signed — the new address on record, newest wins

flows.name: trace-a-payout-to-what-paid-it
flows.description: A settling payout row opens the settlement that paid it — the settlement's own view is still owed.

flows.name: see-a-campaigns-money
flows.description: The wallet's Campaigns door lists what you run and what you took part in; a row opens that campaign's money view.

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-post
flows.description: Press and hold the stance face, wherever a post is drawn, and the pad blooms; the signed stance lands back where it was taken.

end.case: signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: close-the-filter-unchanged
flows.description: The filter sheet opened and shut with nothing touched leaves the feed exactly as it was.

end.case: unchanged

flows.name: filter-the-feed-to-nothing
flows.description: Every kind switched off leaves a feed with nothing left to show — the empty state carrying its own way back.

end.case: everything off

flows.name: filter-the-feed-far-from-the-default
flows.description: A filter pushed far enough from the default that the trigger counts the changes instead of naming them.

end.case: far from the default

flows.name: undo-the-narrowing
flows.description: A feed filtered until nothing shows offers Show posts again — the one control that puts the default back.

flows.name: search-into-a-thread
flows.description: Typing in Explore brings results as they are typed; a comment result opens the thread that comment sits in.

end.case: the comment in its thread

flows.name: narrow-a-search
flows.description: The results' Everything trigger opens the search filter; the sheet applies live, and tapping out leaves the reader on the narrowed results.

flows.name: reply-to-a-comment
flows.description: Reply on a comment opens the same composer pre-targeted at it — one commenting mechanism over many targets, each target declaring its own start and end.

start.case: the composer, pre-targeted at that comment

end.case: signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: reply-with-pictures
flows.description: Pictures added to a reply land in its tray; one seal signs the words and the pictures together into the thread.

end.case: signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: reply-while-the-pictures-upload
flows.description: Next pressed while the pictures are still going up reaches the gated seal; signing waits for them, then the comment settles into the thread.

start.case: uploads still running — the gated seal (master on the media page)

end.case: uploads land — signing proceeds to the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: edit-your-comment
flows.description: Edit on your own comment opens the edit surface; the signed edit settles back into the thread it belongs to.

end.case: signed — the thread, the edit settling

flows.name: publish-words
flows.description: Write words instead takes the wizard's other half — no crop, no cover, the same details and the same seal signing words alone into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: publish-a-video
flows.description: A video takes a step of its own — the cover picks the face the post wears, and details and seal follow the way pictures do.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: cite-something
flows.description: + Cite something, wherever a composer offers it, opens the picker over everything citable; a result row lands the citation in the composer's references.

flows.name: set-your-own-stance-on-your-post
flows.description: Adjust on the seal blooms the one-axis pad — your own post always reaches you in full, so the stance is declared before signing, never assumed.

flows.name: pick-a-kept-draft-back-up
flows.description: New post with a draft kept asks before it opens; Continue resumes that draft at details, and the same seal signs it into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-your-post
flows.description: The own-post overflow offers Edit; the edit surface carries its changes as signed acts of their own and the post settles with them.

end.case: signed — the post, the edit settling

flows.name: remove-your-post
flows.description: Remove asks once, then leaves the mark — the post is redacted where it stood, never silently erased.

flows.name: set-the-cover-and-order
flows.description: Show all opens the picked batch as a list; dragging sets the order, the first picture is the cover, and Done returns wherever the sheet opened.

flows.name: describe-your-pictures
flows.description: Describe the pictures, wherever pictures are staged, opens the sheet; what is written there is witnessed at signing and never gates the upload.

flows.name: publish-while-the-uploads-run
flows.description: Details written while the pictures are still climbing reach the gated seal; signing waits for them, then the post lands in its detail view, still settling.

waypoints.case: uploads still running — the gated seal

end.case: uploads land — signing proceeds to the detail view, still settling

flows.name: see-who-stands-with-someone
flows.description: The figures row, on any profile, opens the stance lists; reading who stands with them is the whole journey.

flows.name: find-the-thread-a-comment-answers
flows.description: A chronicle's Comments tab draws each comment with what it answers; the target pointer opens that post, its thread already open.

flows.name: edit-your-profile
flows.description: Edit profile opens the fields — name, bio, website — and one seal signs them; the picture has flows of its own.

end.case: signed — the profile updates

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-person
flows.description: Press and hold the stance anchor on a profile and the same pad blooms; the stance concludes where it was taken.

end.case: signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: message-someone
flows.description: Message on someone's profile opens the conversation with them — the chat surface is still owed.

flows.name: publish-from-the-browser
flows.description: A browser draws its own pick step — files dropped on the page, no device tray — and the wizard rejoins at the crop, ending on the same seal as the native one.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: reply-from-the-browser
flows.description: In a browser the reply's pictures are dropped anywhere on the page; the tray, the words and the seal are the native ones, and one signature lands the comment in its thread.

end.case: signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: visit-an-author
flows.description: The author chip, wherever a post is drawn, opens that person's profile; their chronicle is what the reader came for.

flows.name: open-a-posts-pictures
flows.description: Post media, wherever a post is drawn, opens the gallery full-bleed; the frames are what the reader came for.

flows.name: follow-a-citation
flows.description: The reference count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the topics-and-references sheet; a reference row opens what was cited — that node's own surface is still owed.
